visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a bright commercial food stall. A man wearing a black baseball cap, a transparent face shield, and a maroon apron is standing at a stainless steel grill. He uses long metal tongs to meticulously flip several circular, golden-brown food items on the hot grate. The background is filled with industrial kitchen equipment and containers. (2) The camera zooms in on the food. The items are flat and have some char marks from grilling. The man picks up one piece with his tongs and expertly threads it onto a thin wooden skewer. (3) A younger woman with dark hair under a blue cap and wearing a red sports jersey appears in a medium close-up. She holds the skewer and takes a bite, her facial expression shifting to one of wide-eyed surprise and intense delight. (4) An older woman in a floral blouse and grey apron approaches with a small white plate. She takes a piece of food and smiles. The background shows a casual dining area with simple wooden furniture and menus on the wall. (5) The man and the young woman are seen together in a medium shot, engaging in an animated conversation. The man gestures with his hands while smiling, and the woman continues to eat with a satisfied look. Yellow and white variety-style captions frequently pop up on the screen.
